events.name: P1A_PUBLICATION
events.requirement: Publish the complete executable protocol and all component digests without candidate identities, statements, rankings, or outcomes.

events.name: P1T_PUBLICATION_AND_RECEIPT
events.requirement: Publish a one-artifact attestation of P1A and prove that the public remote contains P1T.

events.name: U1_CAPTURE
events.requirement: Only after the public P1T receipt, execute the single frozen baseline capture of upstream main and bind its commit and trees.

events.name: ACCUMULATION_INTERVAL
events.requirement: Do not inspect future candidate semantics or close the cohort based on observed quota counts.

events.name: FIXED_HORIZON
events.requirement: Start the one frozen terminal upstream capture within this fixed 24-hour public window; missing the window is terminal chronology failure.

events.name: U2_CAPTURE_AND_HISTORY_REPLAY
events.requirement: Bind U2, prove U1 ancestry, and deterministically compute first introductions in U1..U2.

events.name: PRE_SELECTION_SOURCE_CUTOFF
events.requirement: Acquire and classify every frozen semantic source from P1 through cutoff; semantic or unknown contact excludes the whole cluster.

events.name: QUOTA_GATE
events.requirement: Recompute the future cohort and exact 3/3/2/2/2 counts before entropy.

events.name: ENTROPY_AND_SELECTION_IF_GATE_PASSES
events.requirement: Freeze the eligible pool publicly, then use the inherited future drand selector; otherwise terminate without entropy.

fixed_horizon.selection_basis: Chosen in the pre-P1 scaffold to provide an approximately one-year public accumulation interval.
